prompt: Create a polished anime-style vertical illustration of a gentle young woman relaxing on a beige sofa in a sunlit living room. She has glossy black hair with soft bangs and two long braids, warm brown eyes, delicate round wire-frame glasses, fair skin, and a calm slight smile while looking down at a pink glitter phone case held in one hand. She wears a pale blue and white floral sundress with a gathered bodice and a sheer loose white cardigan, plus a subtle necklace; her other hand is gently petting a sleeping silver tabby cat curled on her lap. Include exactly 2 main subjects: 1 young woman and 1 gray striped cat. The setting is a cozy modern living room with a beige couch, soft blue cushion, wooden coffee table edge in the foreground, large bright window on the left, potted green plant, wooden shelving, framed wall art, and warm afternoon sunlight creating soft highlights and shadows. Use refined Japanese anime illustration quality with semi-realistic lighting, delicate linework, detailed fabric folds, glossy hair strands, expressive eyes, cozy domestic atmosphere, shallow depth of field, pastel colors, and high-detail rendering. Keep the composition waist-up to knees, portrait orientation, intimate and peaceful, no extra characters, no text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一幅精致的动漫风格竖版插画，描绘一位温柔的年轻女性在阳光明媚的客厅里，慵懒地靠在米色沙发上。她留着 乌黑亮丽 的秀发，带有柔和的刘海和两条长辫子，有着温暖的棕色眼眸，戴着精致的圆形细框眼镜，皮肤白皙，低头看着手中拿着的 粉色闪粉手机壳，脸上带着平静而浅淡的微笑。她穿着一件浅蓝白相间的碎花连衣裙，胸部有褶皱设计，外搭一件半透明的宽松白色开衫，并佩戴着一条简约的项链；她的另一只手正温柔地抚摸着蜷缩在她膝盖上熟睡的银色虎斑猫。画面中包含 2 个主要主体：1 位年轻女性和 1 只灰色条纹猫。场景设定为一个温馨的现代客厅，配有米色沙发、柔软的蓝色靠垫、前景中的木质咖啡桌边缘、左侧的大型明亮窗户、盆栽绿植、木质搁架、墙上的装饰画，以及营造出柔和光影的温暖午后阳光。采用精致的日系动漫插画质量，结合半写实光影、细腻的线条、细致的衣物褶皱、光泽感的发丝、富有表现力的眼睛、温馨的居家氛围、浅景深、柔和的色彩以及高细节渲染。构图保持在腰部到膝盖以上，竖屏构图，氛围亲密而宁静，无需额外角色，无文字，无水印。
